shortBio.en: Judas Priest twin-guitar lead; harmony leads with K.K. Downing.
shortBio.zh: Judas Priest 双吉他主音；与 K.K. Downing 的和声主音。

body.en:
Born 1947. Joins mid-70s. Dual-lead grammar with Downing on Breaking the Law, Painkiller. Later health limits touring; still writing seat.

Twin-guitar metal architecture half.
body.zh:
1947 年生。70 年代中加入。与 Downing 在 Breaking the Law、Painkiller 上的双主音语法。后因健康限巡演；仍写作席。

双吉他金属架构的一半。
